results.title: Blankets
results.overview: A mother attempts to resurrect her dead husband with the help of her eleven year old son.

results.title: Hold onto Me
results.overview: 11-year-old Iris learns her estranged father, Aris, is back in town for his own father’s funeral. Determined to know him, Iris tracks him down to a dilapidated shipyard, where he’s been keeping to himself. What begins as a stubborn attempt to reconnect slowly unfolds into a fragile bond.

results.title: Amala Dianor and Les Arts Florissants: Gesualdo Passione @ Nuits de Fourvière 2026
results.original_title: Amala Dianor et Les Arts Florissants : Gesualdo Passione Nuits de Fourvière 2026
results.overview: With their performance of “Gesualdo Passione” at the Nuits de Fourvière, choreographer Amala Dianor and Les Arts Florissants, conducted by Paul Agnew, strike up a dialogue between hip-hop dance and Baroque music that is as unexpected as it is captivating.

results.title: Stardom in Sendai 2026 Mar.
results.overview: Stardom in Sendai 2026 Mar. was a professional wrestling event promoted by World Wonder Ring Stardom, held on March 28, 2026, at Dream Messe Miyagi in Sendai, Japan.

results.title: Newton's 3rd Law
results.overview: Follows an investigation into a double murder in 1999, with unexpected characters roped into the case as they search for justice amid intrigue and secrets.

results.title: Le Muranów de Varsovie
results.overview: A documentary on the story of the cinema Muranów in Warsaw.

results.title: Honey Bunch
results.overview: Diana's husband is taking her to an experimental trauma facility deep in the wilderness, but she can't remember why... As her memories begin to creep back in so do some unwelcome sinister truths about her marriage.

results.title: Pulkam
results.overview: Rispo, a single parent living in a small rented house with his child, struggles through life with many limitations. Every day, he simply tries to survive.  When life feels increasingly difficult, bad news comes from his hometown: his mother has fallen seriously ill and hopes Rispo can return before it’s too late. Rispo then does everything he can to make it back home.  Will Rispo succeed in returning home and meeting his mother?

results.title: One Night Out with Alan Cumming
results.original_title: One Night Out with Alan Cumming
results.overview: Alan Cumming hosts a comedy gala featuring 2SLGBTQIA+ stars performing at the Just For Laughs Montréal festival.

results.title: Wantawsan
results.overview: A poor father receives cash from the newly elected mayor he supported, but when he sets out to buy food for his son's birthday later that day, he's thrust into a comical adventure that tests his values and wit.

results.title: Homo Umbilicus
results.overview: A farmer's belly propels him into an extraordinary world, turning Homo Sapiens to Homo Umbilicus.

results.title: The Wait
results.overview: On the morning of their final IVF attempt, a queer Caribbean couple is transported from a sterile waiting room into ancestral portals of love, lineage, and healing.

results.title: Circo Zarathustra
results.overview: Drawing on the vast body of Nietzsche’s work and weaving together his writings and his thought, Leonardo Petrillo has created a remarkable work that analyses the paradoxical, at times extreme and contradictory thinking of modernity’s most controversial philosopher.

results.title: Bebe Main Badmash Banuga
results.overview: A gangster-in-training kidnaps the daughter of a prominent businessman in an attempt to win his boss' favour, but gets caught up in a web of deceit and conflict.

results.title: Virgin Fandango
results.overview: A short musical film that uses an innovative technique of animated tiles, featuring a rebellious Mary joining her voice to those of celebrated women throughout history in the fight for equality.

results.title: Lingsir Wengi: Motel Malioboro
results.overview: To grow the DuniaHorror62 YouTube channel, Putik—who has the ability to see and communicate with spirits—joins forces with Ryan, Anggie, Aro, Dita, and their friends to visit an old motel in Malioboro. A forbidden room in the motel becomes their target for content, in hopes of making their channel go viral. Despite being warned, this group of young people recklessly enters the room anyway. Inside, they discover a tape recorder containing a recording of the song “Lingsir Wengi.” As soon as the song plays, eerie events and terror begin to haunt them. Putik realizes they’ve awakened a spirit—one that doesn’t just want to communicate, but has come bearing wrath and demanding vengeance be settled. This spirit reveals dark secrets and conflicts within their friendship. They must find a way to stop it before they lose their lives.

results.title: Pennum Porattum
results.overview: When a woman and her dog face public hostility, a village's hidden tensions erupt. A stark examination of mob mentality, social judgment, and how communities can turn cruel when seeking to punish perceived wrongs.

results.title: Murder at the Merriweather
results.overview: When her best friend falls to her death at the luxury resort where they both work, Sophie fights to learn the truth of what happened. But in this world of haves and have-nots, everyone hides a secret.

results.title: Emergency
results.overview: On a cold, quiet night in a nearly deserted emergency room, two children form an unexpected connection. As their innocent conversation unfolds, shadows of a troubling secret emerge beneath the boy’s guarded silence.  In the fragile space between childhood curiosity and hidden suffering, a tender act of compassion emerges…one that could change everything.
